timelineIfApproved.display: Allergy to penicillin V (reaction: anaphylaxis, severe)

alertIfApproved.cardText: Flagged for clinician review. Two records that were previously separate are now linked to this patient by an approved identity link. [Clinic CSV, allergies.csv row 270d9b1e-1293-5791-947a-95c106c286af] documents an allergy coded penicillin V (RxNorm 7984; status active; verification not stated in source; reaction: anaphylaxis, severe). This rule treats that code as penicillin-class. [ER FHIR, MedicationRequest/c3a0fc4f-e1ab-55b9-b01c-a0723f55d945] has an active order for amoxicillin 500 MG Oral Tablet, RxNorm 308192. The amoxicillin label (DailyMed, set d5eba477-e255-4d97-9e16-30543c298680, revised 3/2023) states: "contraindicated in patients with a history of serious hypersensitivity reactions (e.g., anaphylaxis or Stevens-Johnson syndrome) to amoxicillin, clavulanate or to other beta-lactam antibacterial drugs (e.g., penicillins and cephalosporins)". This is a rule-based flag on synthetic data. It does not say what the patient took or tolerated, or what should be prescribed. A clinician decides.
alertIfApproved.cardFooter: Rule BL-AMOX-01 v1. Not checked: cephalosporin cross-reactivity, intolerances, dose, free-text allergies. Absence of a flag is not evidence that no conflict exists. This rule and its wording were not reviewed by a clinician.
